purpose: P5-only boundary-structure discriminant. Do not repeat 799 localization. Test whether a newly specified local boundary property can separate a horizontal-surface candidate from an adjacent vertical-face organization inside already authorized persistent P5 observations.

source_uncertainty.statement: 799 could not separately localize a platform/terrace-like region. It remains unknown whether visible boundary organization provides independent evidence for a distinct approximately horizontal surface versus an inseparable built-mass boundary.

memory_788.rule: Historical tokens are not current perceptual relations and must not be reconfirmed or restored.

anti_repeat_memory.forbidden_repetition: Do not ask whether a platform/terrace region is LOCALIZABLE and do not reuse the 799 candidate-localization task. The new evidence sought is boundary/surface-face separation only.

new_information_sought.instruction: Inside obs_p5_side_wall, inspect whether pixels expose a directly visible boundary configuration that distinguishes an approximately horizontal surface region from an adjacent approximately vertical face region. Use obs_p5_stair_diagonal_799 only as an already localized reference boundary if it helps delimit the inspection; do not require or assume contact with it. The tested evidence must be a visible surface/face orientation change, corner, contour interruption/continuation, or equivalent boundary separation that is independent of merely seeing a horizontal-topped built mass. Do not assign the semantic label platform/terrace from shape alone.

outcome_semantics.SUPPORTED: Authorized pixels directly expose a boundary configuration separating an approximately horizontal surface candidate from an adjacent approximately vertical face candidate. This supports perceptual separation only, not platform/terrace semantics.
outcome_semantics.CONTRADICTED: Authorized pixels directly expose a boundary organization incompatible with the proposed surface/face separation at the tested location. This does not prove absence of every possible platform elsewhere.
outcome_semantics.AMBIGUOUS: Relevant pixels are visible but admit multiple boundary/surface organizations.
outcome_semantics.NOT_OBSERVABLE: Authorized pixels do not expose the tested boundary property reliably enough. This is fail-closed and is not contradiction.

response_invariants: Inspect P5 only and only the exact authorized observation ROIs.
Every provenance ROI must exactly equal the ROI of each observation_ref it cites; do not create a new candidate ROI in this relational/boundary test.
Test only HORIZONTAL_SURFACE_VERTICAL_FACE_BOUNDARY_SEPARATION. Do not repeat 799 by asking whether p5-candidate-platform-region is LOCALIZABLE.

SUPPORTED requires new directly visible boundary evidence separating surface and face; a near-horizontal upper boundary alone is insufficient because 799 already observed that cue without isolating a platform.
AMBIGUOUS is required when pixels admit multiple boundary organizations. NOT_OBSERVABLE is required when the property is not reliably exposed. Neither may be converted to contradiction.

Do not restore 788 LEFT_OF, BELOW or BOUNDARY_JOINS as current relations. BOUNDARY_JOINS may appear in the response only if directly observed for the newly tested surface/face boundary property; it must not assert stair-platform contact.
obs_p5_stair_diagonal_799 is the only new current P5 localization from 799. The 799 platform and junction candidates remain unpromoted.
Semantic interpretation is separate from boundary support. SUPPORTED does not establish a platform/terrace ontological category.
No physical identity, SAME_PHYSICAL_OBJECT, LIKELY_SAME, metric geometry, camera pose, depth, hidden continuation, or cross-view inference.
No LocalObservation creation and no automatic ingestion.
